subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
11. In the consortium lending arrangement where ABC Bank Ltd. is the lead bank,
how should XYZ Bank classify its portion of the loan?
(A)  Classify as standard, since the borrower has remitted payment to the
lead bank.
(B)  Classify as standard, provided the overall consortium exposure is being
serviced.
(C)  Classify as NPA until XYZ Bank actually receives its share of repayment
from the lead bank.
(D)  Recognize interest income on an accrual basis irrespective of receipt
from the lead bank.
(2 Marks)
